summary: Bought and ran one real Ausca Agent Inbox lease over x402 on Base: read the immutable catalog bindings, drew the live 402 v2 challenge unsigned, paid $0.05 USDC, sent one real email through AgentMail, read it back through the inbox capability, then deleted the lease and starred the auscahq/ausca repo.

message.sent_at_agentmail: 2026-09-24T04:42:xxZ (AgentMail send accepted synchronously; exact send timestamp not separately surfaced by the send API, receipt at inbox is authoritative: 04:42:17.501Z)
message.subject: Ausca Agent Inbox test — Frantic #135

github_star.api_response: HTTP 204 (PUT /user/starred/auscahq/ausca), confirmed with GET /user/starred/auscahq/ausca also returning 204

observations.what_it_lacked: SKILL.md alone doesn't give the exact offer_revision_digest — had to cross-reference /v1/offers (or catalog.json) separately to pin the immutable bindings before sending the envelope, otherwise the create call 400s with invalid_request.

observations.detail: Sent the unsigned envelope to POST /v1/open-inbox with offer_id/offer_revision/input only (no idempotency_key/digests). Got HTTP 402 with a base64 payment-required header decoding to: amount 50000 atomic USDC, asset 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913, network eip155:8453, payTo 0x26572ff23c6c52bfb1a69cb0c9114a8be443b422, scheme exact, maxTimeoutSeconds 60, error 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is required'.

Retried the same POST with the full required body (idempotency_key, offer_id, offer_revision, offer_revision_digest, input_schema_digest, output_schema_digest, input) using an x402-capable signer. Signer paid the exact challenge and attached PAYMENT-SIGNATURE automatically.

observations.body_shape: {status:'accepted', invocation:{invocation_id, offer_revision_digest, state:'succeeded', output:{resource_lease:{address, created_at, expires_at, inbox_id, schema, state}}, output_digest, receipt_ref}, inspect_url, resource_access:{kind, inbox_id, capability, extension_authorization, expires_at}}

observations.detail: Sent the test email via AgentMail immediately after inbox creation, then issued one GET /v1/agent-inboxes/{id}/messages?wait_seconds=30. The message had already landed (received_at 04:42:17.501Z, poll issued ~04:42:21Z) so the bounded wait returned on the first page with no continuation needed.

GET /v1/agent-inboxes/{id}/messages/{message_id} returned the message; validated by exact string match of text/subject/from against what was sent via AgentMail's send_message call, plus AWS SES message-id cross-reference on the AgentMail side.

observations.what_the_page_states: L1 Notarized receipt. JSON at api.runx.ai/v1/receipts/notarizations/{digest} confirms publisher.principal_id='ausca', public_claim.venue.id='ausca', subject.id='inbox.receive', amount.cents=5 USD, occurred_at='2026-09-24T04:42:02.373Z' matching the invocation's updated_at. Page itself is a hash-only L1 notarization (content held at Ausca's edge, not exposed to runx) — the HTML view requires JS to render past the base document; the JSON notarization endpoint is the reliable machine-readable read.

observations.detail: DELETE /v1/agent-inboxes/{id} returned {status:'deleted', inbox:{state:'deleted', deleted_at:'2026-09-24T04:42:27.767Z'}} — acknowledged and idempotent per SKILL.md.
